prompt: An arithmetic sequence has first term 5 and common difference -1.
Find the 40th term of the sequence.

distractorCalculations.misconception: Off-by-one in term index
distractorCalculations.rationale: Answer is exactly one common difference too large.
distractorCalculations.feedback: Reaching the nth term takes (n - 1) steps of the common difference, not n.

distractorCalculations.misconception: Sign error on the common difference
distractorCalculations.rationale: Answer reflects the wrong direction of change.
distractorCalculations.feedback: Add the common difference (which may be negative); check whether the sequence increases or decreases.

distractorCalculations.misconception: Omitted the first term
distractorCalculations.rationale: Answer is the change from u_1, not the term value itself.
distractorCalculations.feedback: Add the first term u_1 to (n - 1)*d to get the nth term.

distractorCalculations.feedback: Each step changes the term by d, so multiply the (n - 1) steps by the common difference.

distractorCalculations.misconception: Omitted the one-half in the sum formula
distractorCalculations.rationale: Sum is exactly twice the correct value.
distractorCalculations.feedback: The sum formula has a factor of one half: S_n = (n/2)(2u_1 + (n - 1)d).

distractorCalculations.misconception: Treats every term as equal to the last term
distractorCalculations.rationale: Sum equals n multiplied by the nth term.
distractorCalculations.feedback: The terms change by the common difference; do not multiply the number of terms by only the last term.

distractorCalculations.misconception: Treats every term as equal to the first term
